result.title: Format Strings
result.heading: Basic Information
result.text:
226: ## Format Strings to BOF
227: 
228: It's possible to abuse the write actions of a format string vulnerability to **write in addresses of the stack** and exploit a **buffer overflow** type of vulnerability.
229: 
230: 
231: ## Windows x64: Format-string leak to bypass ASLR (no varargs)
232: 
233: On Windows x64 the first four integer/pointer parameters are passed in registers: RCX, RDX, R8, R9. In many buggy call-sites the attacker-controlled string is used as the format argument but no variadic arguments are provided, for example:
234: 
235: ```c
236: // keyData is fully controlled by the client
237: // _snprintf(dst, len, fmt, ...)
